goal: Determine the smallest evidence-backed update to the Body War Ontology Evidence Workbench that replaces the initial all-node black box with purposeful progressive disclosure, makes controls understandable, adds ontology-grounded card iconography, and makes relation names and directions legible without relying on color alone.
context: The current candidate-local prototype has a passing automated focus-scene witness: baseline 237 nodes and 231 edges; first focus scene 4 nodes, 0 internal edges, and 6 labeled portals. The default no-tour/no-focus state still returns the complete filtered graph. The local gateway can report graph freshness as unknown because a graph commit is unavailable. Current edge styling already varies by relation type, while expanded labels appear in active focus. Human novice comparison remains pending. Research must produce exact implementation and browser-test bindings, but it must not edit product source, alter ontology authority, append the dispatch ledger, or claim comprehension, promotion, deployment, or production readiness.
anti_bias_global: implementation minimalism versus ontology-semantic fidelity versus novice legibility under accessibility constraints

predicted_disagreements.statement: Hewitt may prefer the smallest patch compatible with the current React Flow and gateway owners, while Ashby may reject that patch if it invents icon categories, hides provenance, or collapses relation type, source predicate, and direction; each exposes the other's runtime-only or semantics-only bias.

Hewitt may retain existing controls and the full-graph default for upstream compatibility, while Simon may reject them for weak information scent and excessive visual workload; Simon's simplification is constrained by Hewitt's exact state-machine and ownership evidence.

Ashby may prefer a semantically strict set of redundant node and edge encodings, while Simon may reject the result as novice overload; Simon's simplification cannot merge ontology distinctions that Ashby proves are load-bearing.

agents.angle: current-source, browser-runtime, control-state, and smallest-patch trace
agents.initial_prompt: Read only the frozen dispatch sheet and Inventory packet first, then the current focus-scene Work Pack, OEW accepted source archive/overlay/patches, gateway, focused tests, and current live candidate if reachable. Do not mutate repository files. Produce: (1) a map of every visible top-level button and search control to its source component, state transition, enabled/disabled behavior, and current purpose; (2) the exact default graph-selection path that shows all nodes; (3) the freshness-banner data path and truthful replacement options; (4) current node-card and edge renderer/style owners; (5) the smallest source and test slices for each candidate change. Replay baseline, Start Tour, portal navigation, Back, and full-graph access with browser evidence. Bind every claim to path plus selector or command, record observed counts, and separate current behavior from proposed behavior.

agents.angle: ontology-grounded node and relation visual semantics
agents.initial_prompt: Read only the frozen dispatch sheet and Inventory packet first, then the Body War ontology node index and definitions, current OEW graph fixtures and adapters, focus-scene source, and existing edge/node type fields. Do not mutate repository files. Build a typed visual-semantics matrix that distinguishes business category, node kind, authority/candidate state, relation type, source predicate, direction, and evidence status. For card icons, identify which classifications actually exist in source, which may share an icon family, and which must remain text or badges; forbid UI-invented ontology. For edges, compare unique-per-edge color, relation-type color, semantic groups, line patterns, arrow markers, inline labels, hover/focus labels, and a legend. Require stable deterministic mapping and non-color redundancy. Return exact data fields and source selectors needed to implement each viable mapping, plus every semantic collapse that must be killed.

agents.angle: novice comprehension, accessibility, and graph-visualization precedent
agents.initial_prompt: Read only the frozen dispatch sheet and Inventory packet first, then current OEW screenshots, focus-scene acceptance evidence, and relevant UI source. Search external primary sources only: official React Flow documentation, W3C WCAG material, and primary graph-visualization or HCI papers. Do not mutate repository files. Evaluate progressive disclosure for the default/home view, information scent of Overview/Learn/Deep Dive/Filter/Export/Path/theme/search controls, card icon plus text patterns, edge-label placement, relation legends, color distinguishability, direction cues, keyboard/forced-colors/reduced-motion behavior, and panel occlusion. Propose a measurable novice test with tasks and pass/fail observations. Return a candidate matrix with citations and explicitly distinguish research evidence from design inference.

Reconcile the three explorer returns without erasing disagreement. Produce one exact-binding decision matrix covering: freshness/provenance treatment; each visible control's keep, remove, rename, regroup, or defer status; initial/home projection and explicit full-graph access; ontology-backed card icon taxonomy; edge identity and relation-type encoding; labels, direction, legend, and non-color redundancy; responsive/occlusion behavior; and automated plus human acceptance checks. Compare at least three coherent concepts: tour-first learning shell, bounded business-context home with explicit Overview full graph, and search-first projection. Treat unique-per-edge color as a hypothesis and state precisely why it survives or fails. Select one smallest prototype slice, kill non-viable variants with evidence, name exact source/test targets, preserve unresolved rows, and do not authorize implementation.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Lakatos may accept an existing React Flow or OEW owner as sufficient precedent and reject a bespoke witness that merely retests owned behavior, while Gödel may reject the same recommendation without a concrete fixture, selector, and browser observation; Gödel exposes Lakatos's ownership-deference bias, while Lakatos exposes Gödel's test-overfitting and unnecessary-reimplementation bias.

Lakatos may preserve existing upstream terminology and UI precedent to avoid a new visual-language layer, while Quine may reject the same terms when they collapse freshness, integrity, category, kind, authority, relation identity, or direction; Quine exposes Lakatos's deference to inherited equivocation, while Lakatos exposes Quine's taxonomy-proliferation bias when a proposed distinction has neither a source owner nor an observable consequence.

Gödel may accept a visually working fixture, while Quine rejects it if the witness overstates source semantics or relies on color alone; Quine's distinctions must still produce an observable witness under Gödel's gate.

agents.initial_prompt: Attack the synthesis only on precedent and ownership. Verify what is already owned by the accepted OEW adapter, upstream React Flow dashboard, focus-scene derivation, gateway, browser harness, Body War ontology fields, official React Flow patterns, and prior black-box review. Existing ownership is positive evidence: mark build-from-owned, never KILL merely because a pattern exists. Reject a new generalized visual-language layer, duplicated state machine, invented renderer, or custom accessibility mechanism when an owned seam already suffices. Return exact source bindings and missing owners.

agents.angle: non-vacuity attack requiring executable visual witnesses
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the synthesis only on non-vacuity. Require a concrete Body War fixture and an observable browser witness for: truthful freshness/provenance behavior; every kept control; a bounded initial scene plus intentional full-graph escape; each icon class; at least two relation types with visibly distinct but redundant encoding; always-recoverable edge names and direction; keyboard navigation; and forced-colors behavior. Require exact selectors, expected counts, and pass/fail observations. KILL any recommendation that cannot be exercised without relying on a design adjective such as clear, intuitive, or accessible.

Attack the synthesis only on definitional soundness. Check that graph freshness is not confused with ontology validity; the complete graph is not confused with a black-box interaction state; business category is not confused with node kind or authority state; edge identity is not confused with relation type, source predicate, label, or direction; and color is not treated as semantics. Require a source-backed definition for every icon, badge, color family, line style, label, and legend entry. KILL invented or equivocal mappings and preserve a typed residue list.

After the strategist declares exact-binding evidence closure ready, write findings.md only. Lead with the selected prototype concept and the reasons it solves the user's five observations. Include the current-control purpose map, selected default/home state, truthful freshness treatment, ontology-backed icon table, edge visual grammar and legend, killed variants, exact source/test bindings, browser acceptance script, novice comparison protocol, and unresolved residue. Distinguish automated prototype evidence from untested human comprehension. Do not authorize implementation or claim ontology correctness, release, deployment, or production readiness.

Audit findings.md only against the frozen dispatch goal and exact-binding contract. Verify that it answers all five user observations, explains every visible control, preserves truthful provenance, prevents the initial all-node black box, uses only source-backed icon categories, distinguishes edge identity from relation type, provides non-color edge cues and exact labels, includes source/test selectors, and keeps human comprehension pending until measured. Approve or return one bounded writer revision. Reject implementation authorization, ontology promotion, deployment, production, or accessibility-conformance claims.
